title: The T-map contracts at √3/2: a Collatz census below 10^6, a length-16 parity-vector bijection, and a coral inverse tree
description: The accelerated Collatz map T(n) has a unique coin-flip geometric mean √(1/2 · 3/2) = √3/2. A complete census below 10^6 measures the mean as 0.865312 (relative error 8·10^{-4}). On the same window every orbit reaches 1, the delay record is (837799, 524), and the first sixteen parity vectors are in bijection with residue classes modulo 2^k. The inverse graph on a 433-node window is a tree. These are resolved statements. They are not the Collatz conjecture. Finite-window computational resolution only.
notes: This is a new record and a new DOI. Title the record by the √3/2 contraction, not by the Collatz conjecture solved. Does not prove the Collatz conjecture.
